item.title: M90 Queensferry (Northbound)
item.description:
🔴 Major traffic restrictions
• The M90 is closed northbound between Junction 1a Queensferry and Junction 1b Ferrytoll due to overnight roadworks. The closure includes the Queensferry Crossing and traffic should divert via the Forth Road Bridge.
Updated: 23:31
